subject: TRN v0.1.0 release memorandum
opening: This memorandum covers TRN version 0.1.0 only. TRN ships as an Enhanced Tabular Recipe Notation converter: Streamlit local app plus Cloudflare Pages site trn.f00.sh.

sections.heading: 1. Summary
sections.body: v0.1.0 is the first public f00 product release of TRN. Operators and users convert recipes from URL or paste into dense eTRN process matrices (Markdown table, JSON, printable HTML). Rule-based conversion works without paid APIs. Optional LLM path defaults to xAI Grok.

sections.heading: 2. Added
items: Optional LLM path (OpenAI-compatible; default api.x.ai/v1, grok-3)
recipe-scrapers + JSON-LD extraction with paste fallback
site/ f00-styled converter on Cloudflare Pages project f00-trn
Docs pack: SOP, this memo, man, file_id.diz, CHANGELOG

sections.heading: 5. Security
sections.body: No authentication surface. API keys are user-supplied in session only and are not stored by the product. Do not commit secrets.

steps.text: Use https://trn.f00.sh for the hosted converter.
Local: pip install streamlit recipe-scrapers openai requests beautifulsoup4 && streamlit run app.py
Deploy operators: npx wrangler pages deploy site --project-name=f00-trn --branch=main

sections.heading: 7. Verification
items: Paste a multi-step recipe; convert without LLM; table has ingredient rows and stage columns
Download eTRN JSON; structure includes meta, ingredients, stages, markdown_table
Open printable view; Print preview shows bordered table
Optional: URL scrape against a schema.org Recipe page
Optional: LLM path with valid key returns denser labels
